name: NorthstarSupportChatbot
description: An AI chatbot for handling customer support inquiries, routing user messages to the appropriate category for automated replies.

customer_message.description: The message sent by the customer.

order_id.description: The unique ID associated with the customer’s order (optional).

product_name.description: The name of the product that the customer is asking about (optional).

category.description: The category the message falls into (order_status, return_request, stock_availability, out_of_scope).

final_reply.description: The final composed reply to be sent to the customer.

methods.name: classify_question
methods.description: Classifies the customer message into one of the defined categories.

methods.name: route_by_category
methods.description: Routes the classified message to the appropriate handler based on the category.

methods.name: check_order_id_present
methods.description: Checks if the order ID is present in the customer message.

methods.name: lookup_order_status
methods.description: Looks up the order status using the provided order ID.

methods.name: save_order_reply
methods.description: Saves the order status reply to the state.

methods.name: request_order_id
methods.description: Requests the customer to provide their order ID.

methods.name: save_order_id_missing_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply when the order ID is missing.

methods.name: lookup_return_policy
methods.description: Looks up the return policy details for the asked product.

methods.name: save_return_reply
methods.description: Saves the return policy reply to the state.

methods.name: check_stock_availability
methods.description: Checks the stock availability of the requested product.

methods.name: save_stock_reply
methods.description: Saves the stock availability reply to the state.

methods.name: flag_for_human_review
methods.description: Flags the inquiry for human review due to being out of scope.

methods.name: save_escalation_reply
methods.description: Saves the escalation reply to the state.
